documents.name: Staff Report
documents.synopsis: Staff report recommending denial of Thrive at Warfield's appeal of the Town Manager's process determination for Parcel B site development (BZA Case 2025-04).
documents.description: BZA staff report analyzing the six grounds of appeal raised by Thrive at Warfield. Staff finds that Town Code §108-144(B) requires any PEC plan amendment to proceed through the three-step process (Concept, Preliminary, Final), that the Town Manager acted within code authority, and recommends denial. Recommended motion is to deny the appeal and find the Town Manager acted within authority under the PEC District approval process.

documents.name: Application
documents.original_filename: BZA Case 2025 04 Cover Letter and Application
documents.synopsis: Cover letter and BZA application filed September 24, 2025 by David K. Bowersox on behalf of Thrive at Warfield, appealing the Town Manager's August 28, 2025 site plan process determination for Parcel B.
documents.description: Application package including cover letter from Hoffman, Comfort, Offutt, Scott & Halstad LLP, BZA Notice of Appeal form, certified list of contiguous property owners, and parcel/building ownership information. Applicant is Thrive at Warfield (contract purchaser); property is Parcel B (~3.42 ac), Tax Map 200, Block 5, PEC District; attorney is David K. Bowersox. Six grounds of appeal are enumerated, asserting the site plan should process under the Development Pattern Book without revisiting the Preliminary PEC Plan.
